          definition:
          cashDesk:CashDesk = CurrentStore.AssociationCashdeskes->any(c | c.Id = cashDeskID)
            
            precondition:
          not cashDesk.oclIsUndefined() and not cashDesk.IsOpened and not CurrentStore.oclIsUndefined() and CurrentStore.IsOpened
            
            postcondition:
          let result:Boolean in cashDesk.IsOpened = true and CurrentCashDesk = cashDesk
            
        }
